description: This file provides a helper class for managing local notifications within a Flutter app. It handles initialization, permission requests, showing test and article saved notifications, processing notification actions, and managing notification payloads. The class integrates with platform-specific settings and actions, like creating notification channels on Android and setting notification categories with actions on iOS.

classes.name: LocalNotifications
classes.description: A utility class for managing local notifications, including initialization, permission handling, notification display, and action processing.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the local notifications plugin, sets up notification channels and categories, and requests permissions on Android and iOS.

methods.name: showTestNotification
methods.description: Displays a simple test notification to verify that notifications are working.

methods.name: showSavedArticleNotification
methods.description: Shows a notification indicating an article has been saved, with action buttons for opening the saved articles or undoing the save.

methods.name: getDiagnostics
methods.description: Returns diagnostic info about notification permissions and system notification enablement status.
